title: Technician Field Standards by Tier — Auto Glass Services
content:
Field standard for the glass technicians of Crestline Collision & Glass. Under **Auto Glass Services**, each tier fixes the urethane safe drive-away time, whether moldings and a rain-sensor gel pad are fitted, whether a leak test is run, how many photos are taken, and whether a forward camera calibration order is required and must close before the vehicle is released.

## Section 1. Standards defined

(a) *Safe drive-away time* — hours after installation before the vehicle may be driven (integer, hours; 0 means no bonded adhesive).
(b) *Moldings* — whether moldings and clips are replaced (boolean).
(c) *Rain-sensor gel pad* — whether a new rain-sensor gel pad is fitted (boolean).
(d) *Leak test* — whether a water leak test is performed before completion (boolean).
(e) *Photos* — photos taken before and after the job (integer).
(f) *Calibration order* — whether the replacement requires a forward camera calibration order (boolean).
(g) *Calibration before release* — whether the vehicle is released only after the calibration order is completed or declined (boolean).

## Section 2. Standards by tier

| Tier | (a) Safe drive-away (hours) | (b) Moldings | (c) Gel pad | (d) Leak test | (e) Photos | (f) Calibration order | (g) Calibration before release |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Windshield Chip Repair | 0 | No | No | No | 2 | No | No |
| Side Glass Replacement | 0 | No | No | No | 4 | No | No |
| Rear Glass Replacement | 1 | Yes | No | Yes | 4 | No | No |
| Windshield Replacement | 1 | Yes | Yes | Yes | 6 | No | No |
| Camera-Equipped Windshield Replacement | 1 | Yes | Yes | Yes | 6 | Yes | Yes |
| Premium Feature Windshield Replacement | 2 | Yes | Yes | Yes | 6 | Yes | Yes |

## Section 3. Observations on the table

- A safe drive-away time of 0, on Windshield Chip Repair and Side Glass Replacement, means no bonded adhesive. Rear Glass Replacement, Windshield Replacement and Camera-Equipped Windshield Replacement carry 1 hour, and Premium Feature Windshield Replacement 2 hours.
- Moldings and clips are replaced, and a water leak test is run, on Rear Glass Replacement and on the three windshield replacement tiers; the rain-sensor gel pad is fitted on the three windshield replacement tiers only.
- Photos number 2 on Windshield Chip Repair, 4 on Side Glass Replacement and Rear Glass Replacement, and 6 on the three windshield replacement tiers.
- A forward camera calibration order, and release only after it is completed or declined, are scheduled together on Camera-Equipped Windshield Replacement and Premium Feature Windshield Replacement; no other tier has either.

*Hypothetical example:* glass set on a Premium Feature Windshield Replacement job with an installation time of 09:15 has a safe drive-away time of 2 hours under column (a), which runs to 11:15.
